about.description.message: Why Ahsan Mahmood made LifeWell, the milestones that brought it here, and where to find his work with Zaions.

about.lede.message: Ahsan built LifeWell after listening to his parents tell the stories of their lives. He wanted those moments kept in a place a family could return to.

about.why.first.message: His father told him stories. So did his mother. Ahsan wanted a way to hold on to those conversations and the people behind them. LifeWell grew from that wish into one place for relationships, memories and the ordinary things that sit beside them.

about.why.second.message: The larger vision is a gift that could pass through generations. Some parts of that vision are still being built. Today, the app keeps a record you can return to, with sharing under your control.

about.timeline.heading.message: How has it reached this point?

about.timeline.2025.event.message: the earliest commit in the LifeWell app repository.

about.timeline.2026_09.event.message: the rebuilt web app was verified live against its build.

about.timeline.2026_10.event.message: the owner confirmed version 3.25.0 live on Google Play.

about.timeline.2026_11.event.message: the released web, Android and docs routes were gathered under Get LifeWell.

about.build.body.message: LifeWell is a React and TypeScript app on the web and Android. If you enable offline logging, a small set of quick entries can wait on your device until the connection returns. Sharing is a choice you make for each item, and the record remains yours to export.

home.title.message: The people and moments of your life

home.description.message: Public documentation for LifeWell, which keeps the people and moments of your life in one place: family, friends, memories and plans, with wellbeing around them. Web and Android.

home.feature.people.title.message: The people in your life first

home.feature.people.description.message: You start with yourself and add the people who matter. Memories, the everyday and sharing sit with them, and health, mind and life stages around them. Six of the seven areas can be switched off — off means the menu stops listing it, not that anything is deleted.

home.feature.export.title.message: Your record, and a way out of it

home.feature.export.description.message: Choose a date range and export record data as JSON or CSV, or make a PDF summary. Each table is capped at 5,000 rows per export. Export is on every plan, including Free.

home.feature.offline.description.message: When offline logging is enabled, water, mood and steps can queue on this device while you are offline. Other changes need a connection; check that queued entries have synced before relying on them elsewhere.

home.feature.photos.title.message: Photos stay in your own Drive

home.feature.photos.description.message: LifeWell asks Google for a permission that reaches only the files it created. We hold a reference to the file, not the file itself.

home.feature.no_score.title.message: No streak, no score, no rank

home.feature.no_score.description.message: Nothing here keeps a streak or grades you on a number. A record with gaps in it is still a record, and a quiet Sunday is just a quiet Sunday.

home.feature.honest.description.message: LifeWell's web app, Android app and browser companion have different capabilities. Android reminders need device permission; the extension's store release is pending, and there is no iOS app. The changelog records what has shipped.

ecosystem.meta.message: The other products Ahsan Mahmood builds at Zaions, with a clear way to visit each one.

ecosystem.intro.message: Ahsan Mahmood builds more than LifeWell. Each of these Zaions products has its own job. Find the one you came for, or look around.
